Given arg.
Let v be each x in arg mapped to the value "no" of x.
If _ → include with (v, 1), then
  For each part in the parts of the acting enemy, finish off part.
  Change state to 22.
  Return true.
Otherwise
  If the current state is not 21, then change state to 21.
  Return false.
